test_title: SSC Steno 2021 Official Paper (Held on: 11 Nov 2021 Shift 1
subject: general
question:
**Select the correct active voice of the given sentence.**

Panic has been caused by the sudden lockdown.

options.text: The sudden lockdown is causing panic.
The sudden lockdown has caused panic.
The sudden lockdown is the cause of panic.
Panic is being caused by the sudden lockdown.

solution:
The correct answer is: **The sudden lockdown has caused panic.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in the passive form and in the Present Perfect tense.
 
• The Present Perfect in the passive voice has the following form: **Object + has/have + been + past participle (V3) + (by + subject)**__
 
• The Present Perfect in the active voice has the following form: __**Subject + has/have + past participle (V3) + object**__
 __
 
• Passive: *Selfie has been clicked by the girl.*
 
• Active: *The girl has clicked selfie.*
 
 
 
• ​Therefore, the correct answer is option 2.

 

Correct Active Voice:__ *The sudden lockdown has caused panic.*
